scope_note: Read-only corpus queries and targeted source checks. Examples are diagnostic, not a random accuracy sample. The UI working tree was being modified concurrently. No production changes made by this assessment.

primary_quotes.sql: SELECT count(*) AS findings,count(*) FILTER(WHERE trim(coalesce(supporting_quote,'')) <> '') AS supporting_quotes FROM read_parquet('data/processed/kg_routed_runs/full_corpus_normalization_patch_qa_20260724/findings.parquet') WHERE evidence_type='primary_evidence'

condition_split.sql: SELECT count(*) AS findings,count(DISTINCT study_doi) AS reports FROM read_parquet('data/processed/kg_routed_runs/full_corpus_normalization_patch_qa_20260724/findings.parquet') WHERE endpoint_label_source='condition_text_split'

counts.sql: SELECT count(*) AS findings,count(DISTINCT paper_id) AS reports FROM read_parquet('data/processed/kg_routed_runs/full_corpus_normalization_patch_qa_20260724/findings.parquet')

source_depth.sql: SELECT evidence_type,access_level,count(*) AS findings,count(DISTINCT paper_id) AS reports FROM read_parquet('data/processed/kg_routed_runs/full_corpus_normalization_patch_qa_20260724/findings.parquet') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

prescreen.sql: SELECT prescreen_action,count(*) AS records FROM read_parquet('data/processed/corpus/paper_prescreen_decisions.parquet') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY records DESC

unresolved.sql: SELECT resolution_status,count(*) AS records FROM read_parquet('data/processed/discovery/unresolved_candidate_records.parquet') GROUP BY 1

normalization_audit.sql: SELECT count(*) AS projected_rows,count(DISTINCT study_doi) AS reports FROM read_parquet('data/processed/kg_routed_runs/full_corpus_normalization_patch_qa_20260724/normalization_audit.parquet')

audit_only.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT lower(study_doi)) AS reports FROM read_parquet('data/processed/kg_routed_runs/full_corpus_normalization_patch_qa_20260724/normalization_audit.parquet') WHERE lower(study_doi) NOT IN (SELECT lower(study_doi) FROM read_parquet('data/processed/kg_routed_runs/full_corpus_normalization_patch_qa_20260724/findings.parquet'))

dose.sql: SELECT count(*) AS findings,count(DISTINCT study_doi) AS reports FROM read_parquet('data/processed/kg_routed_runs/full_corpus_normalization_patch_qa_20260724/findings.parquet') WHERE regexp_matches(coalesce("dose",''),'[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f\x7f]')
